verdict.rationale: Stripe (the platform Identity is part of) publishes an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API, as documented at docs.stripe.com/mcp and referenced in the docs pack. However, the evidence doesn't confirm Identity-specific tools/resources are exposed through that MCP server (e.g., creating verification sessions, retrieving results), so agentic support for Identity specifically is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Identity endpoints/tools are included in the MCP server, and independent/community confirmation of using it for identity verification workflows.
